entities.name: 2021 Izmir Peoples' Democratic Party provincial organization attack
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: On the 17 June 2021, Deniz Poyraz, a 38-year-old member of the Peoples' Democratic Party (HDP) was killed in the provincial seat of the party in Konak, Izmir which was under police surveillance. In December 2022, the murderer was sentenced to an aggravated life imprisonment.
